patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,41 @@
-def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
+    # Number to word mapping
+    number_words = {
+        10: "Ten",
+        9: "Nine",
+        8: "Eight",
+        7: "Seven",
+        6: "Six",
+        5: "Five",
+        4: "Four",
+        3: "Three",
+        2: "Two",
+        1: "One",
+        0: "no"
+    }
+    
+    result = []
+    
+    for i in range(take):
+        current_bottles = start - i
+        
+        # First two lines
+        bottle_word = "bottle" if current_bottles == 1 else "bottles"
+        line1 = f"{number_words[current_bottles]} green {bottle_word} hanging on the wall,"
+        line2 = f"{number_words[current_bottles]} green {bottle_word} hanging on the wall,"
+        
+        # Third line
+        line3 = "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,"
+        
+        # Fourth line
+        next_bottles = current_bottles - 1
+        next_bottle_word = "bottle" if next_bottles == 1 else "bottles"
+        line4 = f"There'll be {number_words[next_bottles].lower()} green {next_bottle_word} hanging on the wall."
+        
+        result.extend([line1, line2, line3, line4])
+        
+        # Add empty line between verses except after the last verse
+        if i < take - 1:
+            result.append("")
+    
+    return result
